Title: Systems Engineer
Title reason: DOMAIN_AMBIGUITY

> Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology.
> By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold.
> Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center.
> As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.
# ABOUT THE TEAM
The Anduril Imaging team develops state-of-the-art imaging systems across both hardware and software, deployed to tackle the most significant security challenges of America and its allies.
The team is heavily involved in utilizing computer vision, perception, electro-optical, infrared, and sensor data to give our war fighters and allies an advantage.
# ABOUT THE JOB
We are seeking a hands-on Systems Engineer to join our team as we transition a Ladar product from the Engineering Development Unit (EDU) phase through Engineering and Manufacturing Development (EMD), and ultimately into high-rate production.
You will play a pivotal role in scaling our build capacity to 10s of units per month.
You will bridge the gap between design and manufacturing, lead rigorous testing campaigns, and help mature our hardware and software systems to achieve high Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) ahead of our upcoming Critical Design Review (CDR) and Manufacturing Readiness Review (MRR).
A successful candidate will have a strong background in Electro-Optical (EO) systems, precision pointing, and a passion for transitioning complex hardware from R&D to the production floor.
# WHAT YOU’LL DO
- Drive the EDU-to-EMD Transition: Oversee the deployment and test of our EDU builds, ensuring they are fully prepared to support field testing to demonstrate system capability and performance.
- Lead Qualification & Testing: Design and execute a comprehensive Design Verification Testing (DVT) campaign to environmentally test and qualify the system.
- Prepare for Major Milestones: Author technical documentation, define verification matrices, and lead systems-level preparation for upcoming Critical Design Reviews (CDR) and Manufacturing Readiness Reviews (MRR).
- Scale for Production: Collaborate with manufacturing and hardware teams to implement Design for Manufacturing (DFM) principles. Scale our production capabilities from a few units per year to a target volume of ~10s of systems per month.
- Optimize Test Infrastructure: Architect, design, and ruggedize manufacturing test equipment for efficiency, throughput, and reliability on the production floor.
- Automate & Integrate: Collaborate with software and firmware teams to implement robust test automation, while pushing the user interface (UI) and background software towards product-level maturity.
- Adapt or derive physics-based models of sensor system performance and derive requirements based on those models, and validate models against laboratory and real world data
- Support both laboratory-based and field-based experiments and demonstrations
# REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
- EO/Ladar Domain Expertise: 5+ years of hardware-centric systems engineering experience working with Electro-Optical (EO) systems, Ladar/Lidar, or high-precision pointing systems.
- Development-to-Production Experience: Direct experience transitioning complex, multidisciplinary systems from low Technology Readiness Levels (TRL) to high TRL / production-ready status.
- Testing & Environmental Qualification: Strong familiarity with DVT campaigns, environmental testing standards, and field testing operations.
- Production Scaling Mindset: Practical knowledge of Design for Manufacturing (DFM), test equipment ruggedization, and test process optimization/automation.
- Milestone Execution: Experience leading or heavily contributing to systems engineering reviews such as CDR, MRR, or PRR.
- Collaboration & Communication: Outstanding ability to communicate across multidisciplinary teams (optical, mechanical, electrical, firmware, software, and manufacturing).
- Advanced proficiency in an analytical toolchains/languages (e.g., MATLAB, Python)
- Strong laboratory skills (e.g. design of experiments)
- Willingness to travel to test sites.
- Must be able to obtain and hold a U.S. security clearance.
# PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience with software/hardware integration, specifically defining software interfaces, UI productization, and background software requirements.
- Experience with software/firmware automated test frameworks.
- Knowledge of current and next-generation advanced sensing systems and platforms

> Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates.
> We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.
> These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.
> To ensure your safety and help you navigate your job search with confidence, please keep the following critical points in mind:
> - No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
> - Please always verify communications:
> - Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
> - Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.
> - Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
> - What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.

Our Energy Products practice is looking for an experienced Manager to join the team.
Our Energy Products and Power Market Advisory team combines energy market expertise, production cost modeling, data-led analysis, and commercial insight.
We work with policymakers, regulators, investors, developers, lenders, and energy companies across the energy supply chain, helping clients understand power market fundamentals, assess system evolution, evaluate investment decisions, and shape change in energy markets.
# What you will be doing

- Lead power market modeling workstreams, including scenario design, model configuration, input assumptions, production cost modeling, results analysis, and quality assurance.
- Partner with Energy Products and Market Advisory leadership to define analytical approaches, scope studies, and translate client needs into actionable workplans.

- Present key findings, sensitivities, risks, and commercial implications to clients, senior stakeholders, and internal leadership teams.

- Hands-on experience with production cost modeling tools such as PLEXOS, PROMOD, AURORA, GridView, or similar platforms.
- Proficiency in Python, SQL, Excel, and large-scale data analysis, with a focus on reproducible and auditable workflows.
- Ability to troubleshoot models, challenge assumptions, interpret results, and identify key drivers of market outcomes.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to present technical findings and market insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience leading analytical investigations, QA/QC reviews, documentation efforts, and serving as a trusted technical resource.
- Experience modeling North American power markets (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, SPP, NYISO, CAISO, etc.) and working with key market inputs and datasets.

# About the Role
Carbon is looking for a Senior Production Systems/Test Engineer to join our team of talented engineers in our Santa Clara, CA office.
The ideal candidate is a systems engineer with a passion for solving complex manufacturing challenges -- someone who thrives on digging into difficult problems across hardware, software, and data to find root cause and drive lasting fixes.
In this role, you will lead troubleshooting of our complex end-of-line systems and develop robust test and bring-up processes that make our production line more efficient, self-sustaining, and capable of delivering the highest quality products.
You will be a key driver in building the kind of systematic, repeatable testing infrastructure that lets our production team move fast with confidence -- ensuring every product that leaves the building meets Carbon's exacting standards.
This role is located at our Santa Clara location on Thomas Road.
This role is is a full time in-office job Monday through Friday.
# Responsibilities
- Own root cause analysis and troubleshooting of complex electro-mechanical and optical systems, using data analysis and MES tools to identify, validate, and resolve issues at their source.
- Serve as a key technical resource for the production floor -rapidly unblocking manufacturing personnel when issues arise, driving corrective actions through to full resolution so the line stays moving and problems don't recur.
- Partner with production and cross-functional teams (Design, Systems, Quality, Supply Chain) to implement corrective actions and drive lasting process improvements.
- Develop and maintain reporting dashboards to track, trend, and communicate manufacturing KPIs -turning data into actionable insights for the production line.
- Lead Product Validation Testing (PVT) for new products, building bring-up and end-of-line test processes that are robust, repeatable, and scalable.
- Translate technical findings into updated work instructions and process documentation, ensuring fixes are captured and sustained on the production floor.
# Requirements
- B.S./M.S. in Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering -a background spanning hardware and software is strongly preferred.
- 6+ years in a manufacturing environment, with the ability to manage shifting priorities in a fast-paced setting.
- Hands-on troubleshooting experience with complex electro-mechanical, optical, or similarly integrated systems.
- Proven ability to resolve production line issues using structured root cause analysis (8D, 5-Why, Fishbone, or similar).
- Experience building KPI dashboards and applying statistical tools to identify trends and drive process improvements.
- Able to translate technical findings into clear work instructions, process documentation, and corrective action plans.
- Strong communicator who works effectively across Design, Systems, Quality, and Supply Chain teams.
# Preferred Qualifications
- Experience troubleshooting equipment containing UV lasers, high-end optics, or complex fluid systems.
- Experience in additive manufacturing or 3D printing production environments.
- Experience with scripting tools for querying, analyzing, and visualizing manufacturing data; experience with Splunk or Quickbase a plus
- Experience with Python
